description:
Modify the 'Standard Visitor' badge template to include the Host's Full Name. 

1. Open the Badge Designer and edit the current visitor badge.
2. Add a Data Field for the Host's Name.
3. Add a Static Text label 'Host:' next to it.
4. Save the template.
5. To verify it works, register a new visitor with the following details:
   - Visitor: Alice Verifier
   - Host: Bob Manager (Create this host if needed)
6. In the registration or print dialog, generate a Print Preview of the badge.
7. Take a screenshot of this preview showing 'Host: Bob Manager' and save it to '~/Desktop/badge_host_proof.png'.
